description: Fix two false-verdict defects in the frozen-comparand oracle-lint rule (filename false-negative and nested-quote false-positive) and add a patterns.md author note.

userStories.title: Fix LIVE_DERIVATION_RE filename false-negative (Defect A)
userStories.description: As a plan-time oracle-lint maintainer, I need LIVE_DERIVATION_RE to require the `main` token in a git-ref position (not as a bare word inside a filename like main.ts or src/main.rs), so a frozen integer comparand is no longer silently excused by a bogus derivation token that is really a filename stem.
acceptanceCriteria: In LIVE_DERIVATION_RE (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts:171), the `git diff main` and `git grep ... main` alternatives replace the bare `\bmain\b` word boundary with a boundary that rejects a following word char, dot, slash, or hyphen (so `main` must sit at a ref boundary: colon, whitespace, or end), while the `git show main:` first alternative (explicit colon) is unchanged. [oracle: file-assert grep -nE 'main\(\?\!' src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts]

Red-on-main behavioral probe: the frozen-comparand rule now FLAGS (returns non-null) an oracle whose only derivation-shaped token is `main` inside a filename, e.g. `test $(git grep -c PATTERN main.ts) -eq 3` and the `src/main.rs` variant; this probe exits red against unmodified main (rule excuses -> null) and green after the fix (rule flags). [oracle: bun -e 'import {RULES} from "./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts"; const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand"); process.exit(r.test("test $(git grep -c PATTERN main.ts) -eq 3") && r.test("test $(git grep -c PATTERN src/main.rs) -eq 3") ? 0 : 1)']

Non-regression: the frozen-comparand rule still returns null (excused) for every genuine derivation ref shape piped to a numeric counter: `git show main:PATH`, a bare `git grep PATTERN main` tree grep, a `git grep PATTERN main:src/f.ts` ref, and a `git diff main -- f.ts` diff. A flagged-forms row and a rejected-forms row exist per accepted ref shape and per rejected filename shape in test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts. [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts]

The adjacent existing boundary test (patterns.md-style `mainbranch:file.ts` correctly does NOT match, since `b` is a word char) at test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts still passes. [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts]

The oracle-lint fixture test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt gains a `frozen-comparand :: flag :: ...` row for the `main.ts` filename false-negative (and the `src/main.rs` variant), consumed by the existing table-driven matrix test, and the fixture-shape guard still passes. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'main.ts' test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes including the per-function line ceiling noExcessiveLinesPerFunction (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts (LIVE_DERIVATION_RE line 171), test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts (flagged forms ~195, passing cases ~273, findFrozenComparandRule helper line 71), test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt (format `<ruleName> :: <ok|flag> :: <command>`). Exact fix (measured 8-case matrix 0-wrong on unmodified main): use a negative-lookahead `(?![\w./-])` after `main` in BOTH the `git diff main` and `git grep ... main` alternatives; `git show main:` is fine. MANDATORY oracle-authoring discipline: every acceptance oracle string is itself scanned by the rule you are modifying; single-quote comparison-shaped case strings, avoid possessive apostrophes, and run each intended oracle through the exported RULES array (import RULES, call rule.test) to confirm zero self-findings BEFORE finalizing. NEVER let `bun test <file>` be a behavioral criterion's SOLE red-on-main oracle (an ADDED test can't be red on main): the inline `bun -e` probe importing RULES is the falsifiability witness. macOS host: no `timeout`, foreground `sleep` harness-blocked; write any probe payload to /tmp (never under .claude/, which trips the plan preflight clean-tree guard) via heredoc + String.raw, and print a row COUNT so vacuity is visible. patterns.md context: CAM-388 quote-stripping bullet (frozen-comparand is quote-blind by design) and CAM-377 derive-don't-freeze bullet (why the frozen-integer rule exists) are the relevant grep targets under the oracle-lint keywords. No _ref bump needed (prd-oracle-lint.ts and its test are not in scripts/file-size-budget.json), but keep touched functions tight for noExcessiveLinesPerFunction.

userStories.title: Fix nested-quote false-positive in extractCommandSubstitutionSpans (Defect B, subsumes CAM-389)
userStories.description: As a plan-time oracle-lint maintainer, I need extractCommandSubstitutionSpans to recursively strip quoted spans inside a preserved $(...) command substitution, so inert single-quoted comparison data nested in a double-quoted command substitution is no longer scanned and falsely flagged, while genuine derivation refs inside $(...) still survive.
acceptanceCriteria: extractCommandSubstitutionSpans (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts:300-316) recurses stripQuotedSpans over the preserved `$(...)` inner content instead of splicing it verbatim, creating mutual recursion with stripQuotedSpans (caller ~line 378); recursion terminates because each level operates on a strictly smaller inner substring. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'stripQuotedSpans' src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts]

Red-on-main behavioral probe (Defect B false-positive): the frozen-comparand rule now returns null for a double-quoted command substitution whose only numeric comparison is inert single-quoted data (a double-quoted dollar-paren grep whose single-quoted pattern contains a numeric equality); this probe exits red against unmodified main (rule flags) and green after the fix (rule returns null). [oracle: bun -e 'import {RULES} from "./src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts"; const r=RULES.find(x=>x.name==="frozen-comparand"); process.exit(r.test(String.raw`echo "$(grep -c '\''X -eq 1'\'' f.ts)"`) === null ? 0 : 1)']

Non-regression: the rule still FLAGS a genuine `wc -l` pipeline whose count is compared to a bare literal integer, and still EXCUSES a real `git show main:PATH` derivation nested in a command substitution (the unquoted derivation token survives recursion). Matrix rows for both directions exist in test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts. [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts]

Recursion terminates on a deeply nested input (no hang / stack overflow); the accepted residual limit (2+level nested double-quoted command substitutions are not fully stripped) is noted in a code comment as a limit, not a bug. [oracle: file-assert grep -qi 'limit' src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts]

The oracle-lint fixture test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt gains rows covering the inert-nested-data false-positive (a `frozen-comparand :: ok :: ...` row) and its genuine-flag counterpart, consumed by the table-driven matrix test, and the fixture-shape guard still passes. [oracle: named-command bun test test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
Lint spine passes including noExcessiveLinesPerFunction (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts (extractCommandSubstitutionSpans 300-316, stripQuotedSpans 361-390, findCommandSubstitutionEnd), test/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.test.ts, test/fixtures/oracle-lint/oracle-lint-cases.txt. Requires US-001 because both stories edit prd-oracle-lint.ts, its test, and the same fixture file; serialize to avoid add/edit collisions. Exact fix (measured false-positive on unmodified main): inside extractCommandSubstitutionSpans, recurse stripQuotedSpans over the preserved $(...) inner content instead of splicing verbatim, so nested quoted data is stripped while the unquoted command structure (including derivation refs) survives; terminates because the inner slice is strictly shorter. Residual accepted limit: 2+level nested double-quoted command substitutions are not fully stripped (astronomically rare in oracle criteria) -> document as a limit. Same MANDATORY oracle-authoring discipline as US-001: every oracle string is scanned by the rule under change, single-quote comparison-shaped case data, avoid possessive apostrophes, sweep each oracle through the exported RULES array for zero self-findings BEFORE finalizing, and keep `bun test <file>` out of the sole-oracle slot (use the inline `bun -e` RULES probe as the red-on-main witness). This story is the CAM-389 fix site; CAM-389 is closed by the operator by hand as subsumed after a CLEAN review (NOT a worker task). patterns.md grep targets: CAM-388 US-R2-002 bullet (preserve $(...) content specifically, not quoted spans generally) is the precedent this fix follows. macOS: probe payloads to /tmp via heredoc + String.raw, never under .claude/.

userStories.title: Add patterns.md author note for the two-clause exit-code idiom footgun
userStories.description: As an oracle author, I need a patterns.md note near the frozen-comparand guidance explaining that per-clause scoping flags the two-clause exit-code idiom by design, so I keep the derivation token and its comparand in one clause instead of tripping a legitimate-but-surprising BLOCK.
acceptanceCriteria: patterns.md gains a note for oracle authors near the frozen-comparand guidance (around patterns.md:903) stating that the two-clause exit-code idiom (e.g. a `git diff main --quiet` check whose exit code is tested in a following clause) is flagged BY DESIGN because the derivation token and the comparand sit in different clauses, and that authors must keep them in one clause or re-derive in the same clause; the note cross-references the frozen-comparand guidance by absolute line number. [oracle: file-assert grep -q 'two-clause exit-code' scripts/cam/patterns.md]
The note is placed adjacent to the existing frozen-comparand / derive-don't-freeze guidance (not appended at an unrelated section). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test]
userStories.notes: File: scripts/cam/patterns.md (place near the frozen-comparand / derive-don't-freeze guidance around line 903).
